Definition
[Admissible class for Stokes' problem] 1. ch8:8.4.4-def-1\group Incompressible Fluids The set $\mathcal A$ is the admissible class for Stokes' problem.

Let $\mathbf u\in \mathcal A$ be the unique minimizer of $I$ over $\mathcal A$.
